title: hudsonia ericoides subsp. tomentosa
intro: Hudsonia ericoides subsp. tomentosa, commonly known as Hudson's Bay tea, is a plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Hudson's Bay tea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Hudson's Bay tea for medicinal purposes.
